summary: Source and host control show one complete parallel SpMV per counted repetition. The clocked host loop invokes GOMP_parallel at 0x1b36 and branches to its loop head until the requested count. The worker partitions rows with nnz lower_bound cuts, then visits each assigned row and every stored nonzero, accumulating indexed products and storing each output, including zero for empty rows.

source_evidence.claim: OpenMP build using optimized native flags.
Thread row boundaries are based on nnz lower_bound with endpoint cases; each row kernel covers all CSR entries; parsed dimensions/count, initialization and timed count loop are shown.

compiled_evidence.claim: Clocked host executes counted GOMP_parallel calls at 0x1b36 with loop backedge to 0x1a80. Outlined worker calculates partition boundaries, loops rows and nonzeros, performs multiply/add and stores output (zero for empty rows).
